name: grimmsnarl_ml_v1
deck_note: Switched from the v7 list (21c3f20980827cb2) to the list 21 of the top-50 Grimmsnarl teams run card for card: -2 Handheld Fan 1161, +1 Pokegear 3.0 1122, +1 Tool Scrapper 1137. Everything else is identical.
policy: Imitation ranker over the top-50 Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex corpus. MAIN decisions (context 0, single pick, 2+ options) are the ranker's argmax with no rule veto; every other context stays with the marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7 rule policy. The model is a LightGBM lambdarank booster (1273 trees) trained on 148,028 MAIN decisions from 21 top-50 pilots sharing one deck list, with the acting pilot exposed as a categorical feature and pinned at inference to team 16421840. Early stopping is on strict Top-1, not NDCG. There is no residual chain: the ranker reads the observation only.
validation_scope: 63 inherited golden-state tests pass against the real vendor card database. Deck is 60 cards, 19 unique, hash matches the reference top-50 list. Offline strict Top-1 on that pilot's held-out chronologically-later games: 91.55% (n=485). End-to-end runtime agreement replaying the same games through main.py: 91.13% (Wilson 95% 88.27-93.35%), a 0.42-point gap, with 0 feature errors, 0 scoring errors and 0 illegal indices. Latency p95 65 ms per MAIN decision on replays, ~10 ms/move average over a full game on the cg engine. 20 real self-play games vs marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7: 16-4, 0 crashes, 0 illegal selects. Ladder rating is NOT measured yet.
description: First ML agent for the Grimmsnarl line. Replaces hand-written MAIN sequencing with imitation of the top-50 field, conditioned on a single chosen pilot.
